subject: Re: IFEval kickoff — instruction-following as a release gate
body: Status. Evalline integration is live in staging — IFEval runs behind the runner API, and Oyin's converter handles the fleet's response format (that mismatch cost us a week; watch for double-escaped newlines, they silently fail four instruction types). Baseline sweep: our 8B instruct model scores 58.9 prompt-level strict / 66.0 loose; the 34B scores 74.2 / 79.8. Distillation recipe: first end-to-end run finished — teacher sampling plus IFEval-filtered finetuning lifts the 8B to 62.1 strict (+3.2). Short of the +5 target, but the response filter is still crude (keeps only fully-compliant samples; we're testing per-instruction credit). Risk to flag: filtered data skews short — loose-accuracy gains lag strict, and MMLU dipped 0.4. Rafael is ablating filter strictness this week. — Yusuf
